notes: The flagged literal 8 is the byte-lane width (8i+7..8i), fixed by the AXI-Lite 32-bit data format, not PARA_NUM_REGS or PARA_ADDR_W. I kept it and added the nnc-literal-ok comment. All parameter-dependent widths and loop bounds already use PARA_NUM_REGS and PARA_ADDR_W. I did not compile or simulate this.
